sweep.protocol: STR pairs: clean row + corrupted row (other prompt of the pair) per directed case; spawns parent = corrupted, clean = clean
sweep.command: python scripts/ext7_wino_sweep.py --model qwen3 --pairs data/wino_role/pairs_qwen3.parquet --case-sets data/wino_role/case_sets_qwen3.json --out wino_role_qwen3_str --splits discovery,validation,rep_discovery,rep_validation --kinds layer,attn_layer,block --agent ext7-controls

joint.command: python scripts/ext7_wino_joint.py --model qwen3 --pairs data/wino_role/pairs_qwen3.parquet --case-sets data/wino_role/case_sets_qwen3.json --out wino_role_qwen3_str --splits discovery,validation,rep_discovery,rep_validation --agent ext7-controls

direct_split.command: python -m moetrace.ext7_controls direct --model qwen3 --pairs data/wino_role/pairs_qwen3.parquet --case-sets data/wino_role/case_sets_qwen3.json --out wino_role_qwen3_str --splits discovery,validation,rep_discovery,rep_validation
